info.name: Shop — Part 14
info.description: Import this collection AND shop_local.postman_environment.json. Select the environment, change only baseUrl, run Auth, then run any complete folder from its first request (00 | Prepare). SQL migrations/seeds 001–013 must already be applied. Each folder creates unique disposable fixtures and logs in a seeded fake admin; no seed products/accounts are edited. Every request asserts one exact expected status. Expected 400/401/402/403/404/409 responses are deliberate passing negative tests. Tokens/IDs are stored automatically. Use a local coursework database, payment simulation enabled. Do not run individual dependent requests before the folder setup.
